images.title: Readiness Radar Tablet
images.caption: The assessment methodology made visible as a premium product object.
images.motif: tablet, radar geometry, score signals, blank dossier
images.palette: white, steel grey, blue, soft green
images.prompt: Single close-up editorial product photograph of a tablet on a clean white work surface showing an abstract readiness radar chart and simple score shapes, all fictional and without readable text. Beside it are blank profile pages, a graphite pen, and a small green status marker. The image should feel like a trusted acquisition readiness system, sharp editorial, futurist minimal, calm confidence, premium but practical. No readable text, no logos, no real names, no private data, no collage, no grid, no split panels. Single coherent frame, one composed scene or object detail, not a collage, not a grid, not a contact sheet, not a scrapbook, not a mood board layout.
